text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Stage 1 of the U.A.F. qualifiers is 
finally here. Many competitors have 
gathered, and the tournament is being 
livestreamed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems the preliminaries Sonon Elfie is 
competing in are at a different venue. I 
receive words of encouragement via Ryoka 
Tsurugi, hoping we'll meet on the higher 
stage.
